A Bit About Us

We are market leaders bringing together publishers, advertisers, and creators to build the ultimate video discovery experience. Primis is committed to enhancing publisher sites with rich content and growing video revenue streams.

Our team is what makes us shine. We push for more and never settle for less. If you are driven, want to make waves in the ad tech industry, and are passionate about video,
